procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
CAY 226001 was represented by Charlotte Webster.
The Race Committee was represented by Fabian Bach
Tracker log with timing was presented by the Race Committee
facts: On June 27 CAY 226001 was racing with a tracker supplied by the OA.
On June 27, the protest time limit for the ILCA 6 open was 15:24.
CAY 226001 came ashore and signed in at the ramp at 14:43.
CAY 226001 Returned her tracker to the race office at 15:26.
The RC applied a scoring penalty of 2% to her score in race 3.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor omission of the race committee. Therefore the requirements in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
